content:
I removed a ton of backward.isDefEq.respectTransparencys in FLT#908 but there are still plenty left in the repo. Often they correspond to instances which are no longer reducibly defeq. I'm documenting a couple which might be thorny to fix here. I might add more as I triage, although term starts tomorrow and so I'll be back giving FLT lectures for the next 3 weeks and this will seriously curtail how much time I have for tidying up stuff like this for a while.

import Mathlib

/-
Gouezel PR fixes this but held up on discussion about whether RingHom.comp
should be instance-reducible. See
https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/287929-mathlib4/topic/.60SMul.20.E2.84.9D.20.E2.84.82.60.20diamond/near/590787383
and mathlib PRs linked there.
-/

/--
error: Tactic `rfl` failed: The left-hand side
  Complex.SMul.instSMulRealComplex
is not definitionally equal to the right-hand side
  DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul.toSMul

⊢ Complex.SMul.instSMulRealComplex = DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul.toSMul
-/
#guard_msgs in
example :
    (Complex.SMul.instSMulRealComplex : SMul ℝ ℂ) =
    DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul.toSMul := by
  with_reducible_and_instances rfl

/-
`QHat.lowestTerms` in `Data/QHat`.

Just raised this here
https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/287929-mathlib4/topic/.60SMul.20.E2.84.A4.20.28.E2.84.9A.20.E2.8A.97.5B.E2.84.A4.5D.20.E2.84.9D.29.29.60.20diamond/near/591007851

PS love the URL above -/

/--
error: Tactic `rfl` failed: The left-hand side
  TensorProduct.instSMul
is not definitionally equal to the right-hand side
  SubNegMonoid.toZSMul

⊢ TensorProduct.instSMul = SubNegMonoid.toZSMul
-/
#guard_msgs in
open scoped TensorProduct in
example : (TensorProduct.instSMul : SMul ℤ (ℚ ⊗[ℤ] ℝ)) =
    SubNegMonoid.toZSMul := by
  with_reducible_and_instances rfl
